2608.13708.title: TeachMateGPT: A Multi-Agent Knowledge-Grounded Framework for Pedagogical Assessment Generation from Science Curriculum Materials
2608.13708.paper_summary: Automatically generating textbook-grounded assessment items can reduce science teachers' workload, but existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems rely on flat retrieval, support only single-question generation, lack safeguards against weak evidence, and are ill-suited to low-resource, board-exam-structured curricula. We address these limitations with TeachMateGPT, a multi-agent system contributing four advances to curriculum-grounded science-assessment authoring. (i) COPE, a hierarchical knowledge base replacing token-window chunking with a multi-resolution index that segments documents along syllabus structure and links them at three granularities via a traversable graph-based lineage, matching evidence to each topic's instructional level. (ii) A staged, fail-closed agent pipeline replacing one-shot retrieve-then-generate: routing gates search, retrieval fuses dense and lexical evidence under a coverage gate that withholds generation on insufficient evidence, and specialist agents draft objective and constructed-response items. (iii) SAVER, a source-attributed verification protocol scoring faithfulness, relevance, and hallucination risk against retrieved evidence, applying stricter grounding checks across each creative question's four sub-parts, paired with teacher-in-the-loop evaluation rather than automatic filtering. (iv) NCTB-SciGen8, a curriculum-grounded dataset of 198 items (143 multiple-choice, 55 creative questions) spanning all 14 chapters of the NCTB Class 8 science textbook, produced by the pipeline and rated by three practicing teachers. TeachMateGPT raises faithfulness (0.68 $\rightarrow$ 0.96) and answer relevancy (0.60 $\rightarrow$ 0.89) over a vanilla RAG baseline.
2608.13708.paper_summary_zh: 自動生成基於教科書的評估項目可以減輕科學教師的工作負擔，但現有的檢索增強生成（RAG）系統依賴於平面檢索，只支持單一問題生成，缺乏針對弱證據的保障，且不適合低資源的、以考試為結構的課程。我們通過TeachMateGPT解決這些限制，這是一個多代理系統，為基於課程的科學評估創作帶來四項進展。(i) COPE，一個層次化知識庫，用多解析度索引取代了標記窗口分塊，沿著大綱結構對文檔進行分段，並通過可遍歷的基於圖的血統在三個粒度上將它們鏈接，將證據與每個主題的教學水平相匹配。(ii) 一個分階段的、失敗關閉的代理管道取代了一次性檢索然後生成：路由閘搜索，檢索在一個覆蓋閘下融合密集和詞彙證據，該閘在證據不足時拒絕生成，專家代理草擬客觀和建構性反應項目。(iii) SAVER，一個來源歸屬的驗證協議，對檢索證據的真實性、相關性和幻覺風險進行評分，對每個創意問題的四個子部分應用更嚴格的基礎檢查，並結合教師參與的評估，而非自動過濾。(iv) NCTB-SciGen8，一個基於課程的數據集，包含198個項目（143個選擇題，55個創意問題），涵蓋NCTB八年級科學教科書的所有14章，由該管道生成並由三位在職教師評分。TeachMateGPT提高了真實性（0.68 $\rightarrow$ 0.96）和答案相關性（0.60 $\rightarrow$ 0.89），超過了原始RAG基準。
